description: You're helping digitize your late grandmother's collection of family photographs, letters, and documents. Your aunt has scanned 12 items and you need to create a proper archival catalog spreadsheet. Read the item details from /home/ga/Documents/catalog_items.txt and create a searchable catalog at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/family_archive_catalog.xlsx with proper metadata, catalog IDs (format: HEND-YYYY-###), conservation priorities based on condition, conditional formatting, and summary statistics with formulas.
